description: This file defines a base class for testing MediaKeys IPC functionality, including methods for creating and destroying IPC channels, subscribing/unsubscribing to events, creating key sessions, and handling responses and events related to media key management.

classes.name: MediaKeysIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing common setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing MediaKeys IPC interactions, including managing event subscriptions, key session creation, and event handling.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Initializes the MediaKeys IPC channel, sets up event subscriptions, and creates the MediaKeysIpc object.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Cleans up the MediaKeys IPC channel and resets the MediaKeysIpc object.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to specific IPC events and assigns handlers.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from IPC events.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session and sets the response handler.

methods.name: createLicenseRenewalEvent
methods.description: Constructs a LicenseRenewalEvent message with current data.

methods.name: setCreateMediaKeysResponse
methods.description: Sets the media keys handle in the create media keys response message.

methods.name: setCreateKeySessionResponseSuccess
methods.description: Sets the key session ID and success status in the create key session response message.

methods.name: convertMediaKeyErrorStatus
methods.description: Converts internal MediaKeyErrorStatus enum to protobuf error status.
